page_title: NIC 1-1 AUX | Nice v Auxerre 14/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) is penalised for a foul. Abdelatif Kherradji had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+8' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Moise Bombito (Nice), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
90+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Ado Onaiwu displays great vision and sends a pass to Florian Aye (Auxerre), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top of the net. The score is 1:1.
90+3' Marcin Bulka (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+2' Marcin Bulka (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+1' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle and it's Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Lilian Nalis has decided to make a change due to the red card. Ali Abdi is brought on as a substitute for Evann Guessand (Nice).
90' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) whips in a cross from the corner, but Marcin Bulka is well positioned and punches the ball away.
87' Melvin Bard (Nice) is able to continue to play.
87' Melvin Bard (Nice) takes out his opponent with a terrible tackle and is sent off by the referee!
86' Melvin Bard (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
86' Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
85' Great save! Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Donovan Leon.
84' Lilian Nalis has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeremie Boga (Nice) replacing Gaetan Laborde.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tom Louchet departs the field of play to be replaced by Antoine Mendy (Nice).
81' Pablo Rosario (Nice) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

80' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the bottom left corner. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Marcin Bulka with a fabulous save. Auxerre get a corner.
80' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) steps up to send the ball in.
79' Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
78' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
76' Christophe Pelissier has decided to make a change. Han-Noah Massengo (Auxerre) replaces Sinaly Diomande.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre) for Elisha Owusu.
76' A fine individual run by Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre) culminates with a rocket of a shot from long range, but the ball fizzes just wide of the left post.
74' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Marcin Bulka was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.

73' Wow, what an escape. Tom Louchet (Nice) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Wasted opportunity. Gaetan Laborde (Nice) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
72' Tom Louchet (Nice) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Donovan Leon to dive and make a save.
71' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
68' Lilian Nalis has decided to substitute Sofiane Diop and he is replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice).
68' Substitution. Baptiste Santamaria walks off the pitch and Pablo Rosario (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
67' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gaetan Laborde (Nice) who loops his header high over the bar.
67' The ball is out of play and Nice manage to earn a corner.

66' Sofiane Diop (Nice) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Donovan Leon makes a great save to stop his effort. Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the right side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Donovan Leon.
65' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Sofiane Diop (Nice) offside.
63' Today's match ends for Gideon Mensah who will be replaced by Florian Aye (Auxerre).
63' Christophe Pelissier decides to make a substitution. Theo Bair will be replaced by Fredrik Oppegard (Auxerre).
63' Christophe Pelissier is forced to make a change. Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) is unable to continue due to injury, Lassine Sinayoko comes on.
61' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' The ball is laid off to Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Marcin Bulka to make a decent save.
57' Chance! Melvin Bard (Nice) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Evann Guessand, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
56' Melvin Bard (Nice) controls a cross from Sofiane Diop inside the box, but sidefoots the ball just over the bar.
54' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) wasted a golden chance to score after he found some space inside the box and unluckily volleyed the ball narrowly over the bar.
54' There's an opportunity for Tom Louchet (Nice) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

54' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Nice win a corner.
54' Tom Louchet (Nice) takes the corner which is cleared.
53' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) plays a through ball but overhits it.
50' Gaetan Perrin links up with Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre), who fires just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
49' Good defending. Dante (Nice) tries to find Evann Guessand inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
48' Tom Louchet (Nice) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
46' Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) makes a rough challenge and Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The whistle blows and Abdelatif Kherradji starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Tom Louchet (Nice) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
45+2' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.

45+1' Melvin Bard (Nice) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nice.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Moise Bombito (Nice) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
43' What a big chance! Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post.

42' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
40' Tom Louchet (Nice) tries to find Melvin Bard, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is out of play. Auxerre will take a throw-in.
37' 1 - 0 Goal! Gaetan Laborde gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Evann Guessand (Nice) glances a header into the net. 1:0.
37' Tom Louchet (Nice) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

37' He should have scored! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
35' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Theo Bair, who fails to shoot.
35' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) sprays a pass out to Sofiane Diop, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
33' Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the left post.
31' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
29' The referee is firm and issues Kevin Danois (Auxerre) a deserved yellow card.
26' A short pass from Hicham Boudaoui puts Gaetan Laborde (Nice) in the clear inside the box with just the keeper to beat, but his shot sails high over the bar.
25' 0:1 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

25' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Marcin Bulka was alert and the score remains the same.
25' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
24' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Auxerre will have an opportunity.
23' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) attempts to release Theo Bair with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.

22' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
21' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
20' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Abdelatif Kherradji saw the whole situation. Auxerre have a free kick.
20' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
19' The game is interrupted now, Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Nice.
15' Tom Louchet (Nice) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
13' A crossfield pass from Dante (Nice) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
11' Sofiane Diop (Nice) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Hicham Boudaoui, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
9' Melvin Bard (Nice) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
5' Tom Louchet (Nice) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
4' Evann Guessand (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Nice will have a corner.
2' Melvin Bard (Nice) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Auxerre will have a goal kick.
2' Some neat passing and movement from Nice as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Nice will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Abdelatif Kherradji.
